description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of July 2016 being 116.2, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of August, 2016 will be Rs. 659.63
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific trades based on the Cost of Living Index Number. It falls under public sector services and administration as it deals with wage regulations and worker benefits in specific industries, issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance. This fits Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) which covers "Service conditions and benefits" and "Public service recruitment and examinations."
